purpose: Homepage identity concepts for user choice

concepts.name: 麻了DB · 首页
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished desktop HOME SCREEN concept for a Mahjong plugin inside DBX, landscape 16:10 approximately 1600x1000. This must look like a beautiful, plausible application homepage, not a promotional poster or a gameplay screen. Audience: Chinese developers and database users taking a short break. The user wants memorable Chinese internet humor while Mahjong itself stays normal. Four-player Chinese public Mahjong rules, ordinary human players with normal names, no PostgreSQL/MySQL/Redis characters, logos or usernames. No new database-based game mechanics. No currency/shop/VIP/gacha/daily rewards, no feature-card grid, no giant navigation, no casino gold ornament. Use a very narrow DBX host icon rail and a compact DBX top tab bar so the plugin is visibly embedded in a workbench. The plugin homepage takes the rest of the frame. Build the screen around one strong funny visual idea, beautiful tactile traditional Mahjong tiles, readable Chinese copy, and one obvious primary button "开始牌局". Include a small quiet secondary action "继续上局" and small "玩法" and sound/settings icons. A restrained status line "大众麻将 · 四人 · 单机练习". Small ordinary player avatars may be grouped discreetly with text "三位牌友，随时就座". Keep actual Mahjong tile faces traditional 万、筒、条、风牌、中发白; DBX identity belongs to the frame and tiny tile-back details, not altered rules. All visible text should be crisp, intentionally typeset, concise and correct. Original interface artwork.
Brand name (verbatim): "麻了DB". Tiny English supporting mark "MA DB" is optional, but Chinese name is the identity.
Creative direction: knowingly funny developer break-room humor, sophisticated editorial game UI rather than childish cartoon. Quiet desaturated teal/slate workbench surround and a light celadon main canvas, porcelain tiles with jade sides, restrained coral-red accent. Characterful bold Chinese headline reads exactly "写麻了？摸两张。" with smaller supporting sentence "先放下查询，开一桌麻将。". Use a single memorable hero scene: a charming small, tired-but-relieved anthropomorphic white Mahjong tile with the red character "中", simple black dot eyes and tiny arms, slumped softly against a short stack of ordinary Mahjong tiles, as if taking a work break. A tiny floating terminal-style status pill above it reads "脑力缓冲中…"; this is decorative humor, not a game mechanic. Nearby, one clean terminal prompt fragment shows only "> 下班前，再胡一把" as witty flavor. No code wall, no complex illustration, no office props. Keep the mascot stylish and expressive, not childish, with premium ceramic 3D material and soft shadows. Arrange branding/headline/actions on one side and this compact tactile scene on the other, with plenty of breathing room. Primary teal "开始牌局" button and subdued "继续上局". Make the brand "麻了DB" and the funny headline clear at a glance, not oversized to the point of crowding. A homepage that makes a programmer smile and want to click.

concepts.name: HuDB · 首页
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished desktop HOME SCREEN concept for a Mahjong plugin inside DBX, landscape 16:10 approximately 1600x1000. This must look like a beautiful, plausible application homepage, not a promotional poster or a gameplay screen. Audience: Chinese developers and database users taking a short break. The user wants memorable Chinese internet humor while Mahjong itself stays normal. Four-player Chinese public Mahjong rules, ordinary human players with normal names, no PostgreSQL/MySQL/Redis characters, logos or usernames. No new database-based game mechanics. No currency/shop/VIP/gacha/daily rewards, no feature-card grid, no giant navigation, no casino gold ornament. Use a very narrow DBX host icon rail and a compact DBX top tab bar so the plugin is visibly embedded in a workbench. The plugin homepage takes the rest of the frame. Build the screen around one strong funny visual idea, beautiful tactile traditional Mahjong tiles, readable Chinese copy, and one obvious primary button "开始牌局". Include a small quiet secondary action "继续上局" and small "玩法" and sound/settings icons. A restrained status line "大众麻将 · 四人 · 单机练习". All visible text should be crisp, intentionally typeset, concise and correct. Original interface artwork.
Brand name (verbatim): "HuDB". Small Chinese reading beside it "胡一把" is allowed.
Creative direction: witty, precise, confident and playful; a real sister product to DouDB with an identity of its own. Bright cloud-white DBX frame, misty blue-green content canvas, deep teal typography, porcelain and translucent jade tile edges, one lively coral-red accent. The main headline reads exactly "查询还没完，先胡一把。" and a concise smaller line reads "好牌不一定来，好心情可以先来。". One memorable hero scene: three beautiful oversized physical Mahjong tiles arranged as a clean, dynamic little composition, the middle tile carrying the traditional red "中", accompanied by traditional bamboo/dot tiles; above them a small refined toast styled like a database query success message reads "胡牌成功 · 0.01s", with a tiny green check. This is a joke in the homepage illustration, not an actual live score or a mechanic. Incorporate a tiny terminal-flavored line "> SELECT 好心情;" below the brand or next to the illustration, treated as a small delightful detail. No database product characters, no giant dashboards, no code-rain or fake data tables. The HuDB wordmark should be memorable, with the "Hu" a little warmer and more expressive and "DB" crisp and technical, perhaps the u subtly recalling the silhouette of a Mahjong tile; don't sacrifice legibility. Main content should be spare but not empty, all spacing and alignment exact. Primary deep-teal "开始牌局" and quiet "继续上局". The whole screen should feel light, clever, tactile and usable.
